content: Wetaniyatsie Mariya witsimu'ɨa Ketsutsi kemɨtiukawiri
Hikɨ 'ataxewi tukari heuyewekaku Patsikwa maye'anikɨ, Ketsutsi Wetaniya kaninuani hakewa Ratsaru manukatei, Ketsutsi menukuketɨa mɨkite watsata.
Hikɨ mana mekaniwarukuxeɨrieni hamatɨana memɨtekwanikɨ. Marita kaniwaparewiekaitɨni, hamatɨana mematekai, xewitɨ Ratsaru kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni.

Hikɨ Mariya naaru witsimu'ɨa hɨkɨame waɨkawa mɨraye'axe kane'ɨni, meriyu kiruyari hepaɨ paɨmeme, Ketsutsi ketateyatsie kanikawirieni. Ketateya kaniukawatsiɨxa yɨkɨpakɨ. Naitsarie kiita witsikatiniuye'ɨakaitɨni naarukɨ.
Hikɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama xewitɨ, Kura 'Itsikariutitanaka, miyetuanikekai, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni:
—¿Titayariri katiutuiya 'ikɨ witsimu'ɨa haika tsienituyari 'inɨariyarikɨ, temɨwa'ɨitɨanikɨ tixaɨtɨ memɨkatehexeiya?

Mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni tixaɨtɨ memɨkatehexeiya mɨwara'eriwakaikɨ pɨkatixaɨ, matsi mɨtinawayametɨkaikɨ pɨta mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni. Mɨkɨ watumini maname mahananikɨ mɨhɨritɨariekaikɨ, kaniwati'ɨwekaitɨni muwa memeikamanakai.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Keneuhayewa. Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniuyurieni neteukiya tukaritsie mieme maye'aximekɨ.
Yuheyemekɨ yuhetsɨa xekaniwarexeiyani tixaɨtɨ memɨkatehexeiya. Matsi ne xepɨkanetsihexeiya yuheyemekɨ.
Hikɨ huriyutsixi yumɨiretɨ mekateniutamarieni kename muwa Ketsutsi hayekatei, Ketsutsi xeikɨa mepɨkahekuxei, Ratsaru mexeiyakutɨta mɨkite watsata menukuketɨakɨ mekani'axekaitɨni.
Hikɨ mawari wewiwamete tewa'aitɨwamete meyu'enieka 'axeikɨa mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani kename Ratsaruta memienikekai
yumɨiretɨ huriyutsixi kɨmana memekɨkɨ, Ketsutsi hetsie yuri memɨte'uta'erikɨ.
Kemɨreutaha Kerutsaremetsie
Merikɨtsɨ 'uxa'arieka yumɨiretɨ teɨteri 'ixɨaramete mekaniu'enanani kename Ketsutsi 'uhamiekai Kerutsareme.
Parapa mamateya me'uhapatɨ mekanekɨne meheinakiyuka, mɨpaɨ mete'uhiwatɨ:

content.text: —'Aixɨa ketikɨhɨawarɨwani kemɨ'ane Ti'aitame hetsɨa miemetɨtɨ 'umamie hepaɨtsita.

content: Hikɨ Ketsutsi puxu 'utaxeiyaka hetsiena kananutiyerɨni, kemɨre'uxa:
Teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama 'ikɨ mepɨkahetimaiwawekai meripaitɨ. Kepaukake witsi'anetɨ mayeitɨarie Ketsutsi, 'anake mekanaye'erieni mɨpaɨ mɨre'uxakai hepaɨtsitana, mɨpaɨ mɨreye'atɨakaikɨ.
Mɨkɨ teɨteri hamatɨana meme'uwakai kepauka Ratsaru mutahɨawixɨtsie mɨwayeyanikɨ teukiyata, kepauka menukuketɨa mɨkite watsata, mɨkɨta mekanihekɨatakaitɨni.
'Ayumieme teɨteri mekaneikunake memu'enanakɨ kename 'ikɨ 'inɨari tiuyuri.
Hikɨ paritseutsixi mɨpaɨ mekateniyɨkɨhɨawekaitɨni: «Xepɨneniere 'atsitepɨkateyurieni. Kamɨ yunaitɨ kwiepa memɨtama 'utɨmana mekanekɨne».
Kɨriyekutsixi Ketsutsi kememɨtekuwautɨwekai
Merikɨtsɨ teɨteri memu'axɨa 'ixɨararipa meyutanenewienike, hipatɨ mɨkɨ mekanikɨriyekutsixitɨkaitɨni.
Mɨkɨ Peripe hetsɨa mekaniu'axɨani Wetsairatsie Karereya kwieyaritsie mekatei hetsɨa, mɨpaɨ mekatenita'iwawiya: —Neuxei, Ketsutsi tepeuxeiyaku.
Peripe kaneyani, 'Atɨrexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe, hikɨ 'Atɨrexi Peripe hamatɨa mekanekɨne, mɨkɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ mekateniutahɨawe.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Tukari kanaye'aniri Yuri Tewi nehɨkɨtɨtɨ witsine'anetɨ nemayanikɨ.
Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, xɨka tɨriku 'imɨariyari ka'anukateukieni kwiepa 'ukaweka, yuxaɨta kaniyuhayewa xeikɨa, mexɨka 'anukateukieni, waɨkawa kanititakaimɨkɨ.
Kemɨ'ane yutukari mɨnaki'erie kanitatɨmaiyamɨkɨ, matsi kemɨ'ane 'ena kwiepa yutukari mɨ'uxiwe'erie, kanitawikweitsitɨamɨkɨ, tukari mɨkaxɨwe hexeiyatɨ kanayeimɨkɨ.

Xɨka tewi neti'uximayatsiriwame 'ayeimɨkɨni, kenetsiheweiya. Hakewa nemeyeikani, manarita kaniuyeikamɨkɨ neti'uximayatsiriwame. Xɨka tewi neti'uximayatsiriwame hɨkɨtɨni, ne'ukiyari 'aixɨa pɨtixeiyani.
»Hikɨri ne'iyari kaniyumuinaneni, ¿keri ne'utaineni: “Ne'ukiyari, keneneutawikweitsitɨa 'ikɨ tukaritsie nerainenikeyu”? Matsi hikɨ 'ayumieme nekaninuani 'ena kwiepa.
Ne'ukiyari, witsipetikɨhɨawarɨwatɨ kene'ayeitɨa». Hikɨ xewitɨ kaniutaniuni taheima mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: «Neri witsinetikɨhɨawarɨwatɨ nepaneyeitɨa, tawarita mɨpaɨ nekatiniyurimɨkɨ».
Teɨteri yumɨiretɨ mana memɨti'ukai memu'enana mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni, kename tɨranari heyɨ, hipatɨta mete'utiyuanekai, kename niuki tuayame 'itahɨawixɨ.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Mɨkɨ nehetsiemieme pɨka'utaniu, xehetsiemieme pɨta putaniu.
Hikɨrixɨa 'ena kwiepa memɨtama kaniwatahɨawimɨkɨ 'itsɨkame, hikɨrixɨa kwiepa memɨtama mɨtiwa'aitɨa takwa kananuyehɨiyamɨkɨri.
Peru ne xɨka kwie heima ne'anukuhanieni, yunaime nekaniwarahapamɨkɨ nehepa.
Mɨpaɨ kaniutainekaitɨni tihekɨatatɨ kemɨtimierienikekai.

Teɨteri 'ayumieme mɨpaɨ mekatenita'eiya: —Tame 'inɨari niukiyari tekaniu'enieni kename Kɨritsitu yuheyemekɨ yuhayewa, ¿ketitayari petiutaine kename heuyewetse Yuri Tewi manukuhanienikɨ pe'utaitɨ? ¿Kemɨ'ane pɨhɨkɨ Yuri Tewi mɨtitewa?

Ketsutsi 'ayumieme mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Yapaɨmexɨa xeikɨa hekɨariya xetsata kaniuyeikamɨkɨ. Mexi hekɨariya xehexeiya xekeneu'uwani, yɨriya kapa xeha'iwakɨ. Kemɨ'ane yɨwipa muyeika 'atsipɨkatimate kemɨtimie.
Mexi hekɨariya xehexeiya, yuri xeketene'erieka hekɨariyatsie, hekɨaripa miemete xemakɨnekɨ. Mɨpaɨ katinikuxatakaitɨni Ketsutsi, 'arike heyaka kaniyuti'awieta memɨkaheitaxeiyakɨ.
Huriyutsixi yuri kememɨkate'eriekai
Tsepanetɨ waɨkawa 'inɨarite mɨtiyurienekai wahɨxie, yuri mepɨkate'uta'eri hetsiena.
Mɨpaɨ katinaye'ani Kitsariyaxi Kakaɨyari niukameya niukieya mɨpaɨ mutayɨkɨ:
'Ayumieme mepɨkayɨwawekai yuri memɨteta'erienikɨ, tawarita mɨpaɨ mutayɨkɨ Kitsariyaxi:
Mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni Kitsariyaxi kepauka mixei witsikemɨ'anekai, kepauka hepaɨtsitana mɨtikuxatakai.
Peru mɨyatɨtɨ, hipatɨ teɨteri wa'ukiyarima yumɨiretɨ yuri mekateniuta'erieni hetsiena, paritseutsixi mewamakatɨ mepɨkayuhekɨatakai kapa tukita me'anuyeweiyarienikɨ.
Waɨkawa kaniwanakekaitɨni teɨteri 'aixɨa memɨtewakɨhɨawenikɨ, 'etsiwa xeikɨa wanakekaku Kakaɨyari pɨta 'aixɨa mɨtiwakɨhɨawenikɨ.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniuhiwa: —Kemɨ'ane nehetsie yuri mɨti'erie, nehetsie xeikɨa yuri pɨkati'erie, matsi kemɨ'ane mɨnetsiheyenɨ'a hetsie yuri katini'erieka.
Kemɨ'ane mɨnetsixeiya, mɨnetsiheyenɨ'ata kanixeiyani.
Ne hekɨariya nehɨkɨtɨtɨ kwiepa nekaninuani, yunaitɨ yuri memɨte'erie nehetsie yɨwipa memɨkayuhayewanikɨ.
»Xɨka tewi kenemɨtikuxata 'u'enieme, xɨka yakatikayani, ne nepɨka'ixaneta, kwiepa memɨtama newataxanetake nemɨkanuakɨ, kwiepa memɨtama newatawikweitsitɨanike pɨta nemunuakɨ.
Kemɨ'ane mɨnetsixani'erie, neniuki mɨka'utanaki'eri, kaneixeiyaniri kemɨ'ane mitaxaneta. Mɨkɨ neniuki kenemutayɨ, mɨkɨ kanitaxanetamɨkɨ, tukari 'aye'ayu kepauka mɨtapare.
Ne nekɨmana 'atsinepɨkatikuxata, matsi mɨnetsiheyenɨ'a ne'ukiyaritɨtɨ, kanetiniuta'aitɨani kenemutaineni kenemɨtikuxatani.
Ne nekatinimaika tita mɨti'aita, tukari mɨkaxɨwe mɨhɨkɨkɨ. Tita nemɨtikuxata ne, ne'ukiyari kemɨnetiutahɨawixɨ, mɨpaɨ nekatinikuxatani».
